historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2028-FY2031 average of the base path, anchored to management's 'double-digit base business growth' ex-lenalidomide, discounted for US generics price erosion and PSAI softness; deliberately below the 16.8% equity CAGR, which embeds retained lenalidomide windfall profits that will not recur
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 16.8% exceeds revenue 5yr CAGR 12.1% by 39% and the 3yr EPS CAGR is negative: retained earnings from the FY2023-25 gRevlimid windfall inflated book value without a matching revenue base. Equity CAGR is not a usable growth anchor here.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2021->FY2026 (5yr) and FY2023->FY2026 (3yr), owner-FCF series = reported FCF less SBC (interest income is already outside Ind AS operating cash flow). Owner FCF CAGRs are negative because FY2026 carries 10.9% capex intensity and a working-capital drag against FY2021's 6.6% capex, and because FY2023's base was the first full lenalidomide year. SBC is 0.1% of revenue so the owner and reported FCF CAGRs are within 0.2pp of each other; SBC is not where the growth went.

scenario_narratives.base: The business is mid-way through the gRevlimid cliff (North America -22% in FY2026, -29% in H1 FY2027) and the FY2027 semaglutide API stumble; FY2027 is a flat, ~20%-margin trough year. From FY2028 the base business management already reports as growing double-digit (India +16%, Emerging Markets +23%, Europe ex-NRT ~+14%) shows through at the consolidated level, lifted by semaglutide in India/Canada/LatAm, rituximab in the US via Fresenius Kabi, and abatacept IV. EBITDA margin recovers to 23.5%, the pre-lenalidomide band, not the 28-30% lenalidomide peak. Capex intensity glides from 10-11% back to 7% as the biologics and peptide capacity is absorbed. Owner FCF margin matures at ~11% of revenue, in line with FY2019-21.
scenario_narratives.bull: Semaglutide becomes the next franchise product: relaunch in late FY2027, 6-7m pens in FY2027 and a multiple of that in FY2028-29 across 10+ countries, with Brazil and Turkey following. Abatacept IV approved on the December 2026 goal date and the biosimilars portfolio (pembrolizumab, denosumab, daratumumab via partners) compounds through the decade. NRT and the Nestle JV build a consumer-health franchise with branded margins. Revenue grows 12-13% for three years and EBITDA margin reaches 26.5%, management's 25%+ aspiration with mix gain; capex normalises faster.
scenario_narratives.bear: Compliance risk crystallises: one of the three 2026 Form 483s becomes a Warning Letter, abatacept is delayed a year or more and US supply from the affected site is disrupted. Semaglutide proves a short exclusivity window as multiple Indian generics launch and prices collapse, and the API issue recurs. US generics erosion, PSAI customers backward-integrating and a narrowed Section 232 exemption in April 2027 keep gross margins compressed. Revenue falls 3% in FY2027 and then grows only 3-5%; EBITDA margin stalls at 20% and capex stays elevated longer, so owner FCF margin never exceeds ~8%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Dr. Reddy's as a post-lenalidomide generics and biosimilars operator on the cash it can produce once FY2027's one-offs wash out, not as the FY2023-25 windfall business the market still prices. The component build ties year-1 owner FCF to FY2026 actual, lets margin recover only to the pre-lenalidomide band, charges the current elevated capex until the biologics capacity is absorbed, and treats the semaglutide/biosimilar upside as a weighted scenario rather than a base-case entitlement. The current price (~26x trailing depressed EPS, ~15x EV/EBITDA on FY2026) sits well above the weighted value even on the bull path, which is consistent with Indian large-cap pharma's structurally high multiples rather than a mis-specification of the flows; the required-return table shows the IRR the price actually implies.
key_risks_to_valuation: USFDA escalation of any 2026 Form 483 to a Warning Letter or Import Alert (Bachupally biologics is the site behind rituximab and abatacept)
Semaglutide relaunch timing and the pace of price erosion once other Indian generics launch; the FY2027 pen guidance was already halved
US generics price erosion and payer consolidation: Global Generics gross margin fell to 56.7% in FY2026
Capex intensity staying at 10-11% of revenue for longer than modelled (FCF margin is very sensitive to the capex glide)
INR/USD, EUR and RUB translation: a large share of revenue is non-INR while the model is INR
Working-capital conversion: inventory days ~170 and receivables ~100 days mean each point of growth costs ~0.25-0.4 points of revenue in cash

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: FY2026 weighted-average diluted 833.33m (Integrated Annual Report FY2026, EPS note) plus 1.98m options excluded as anti-dilutive at the FY2026 price, i.e. 835.3m. Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). Treasury shares held by the ESOP trust are already netted out of the basic count.
inputs.sbc_source: Integrated Annual Report FY2026, consolidated statement of changes in equity / cash-flow reconciliation: share-based payment expense INR 326m FY2026 (424m FY2025, 407m FY2024). No cash taxes on net-share settlement are disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in the KPI table). SBC is ~0.1% of revenue: an SBC-light market, so house and street bases nearly coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: Set to 0 deliberately, not because it is immaterial (consolidated finance income INR 7,870m FY2026). Under Ind AS Dr. Reddy's classifies interest RECEIVED in investing activities and reverses interest income out of the operating reconciliation (FY2026 AR line 11414 'Interest income (7,771)' deducted in OCF; FY2024 AR line 9239 'Interest income received' in investing). Reported OCF/FCF therefore already exclude it; deducting it again would strip the cash pile's yield twice.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in FY2026 (INR 1,389m of treasury-share purchases in FY2025 were ESOP-trust buying, not a capital-return program). The flat count is a modelling convention the company funds through a near-zero SBC charge rather than buybacks.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in INR; NSE quote in INR per share. The NYSE ADR (RDY) is a separate instrument with its own ADS ratio and USD price and is NOT used here.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-06T09:59:15Z (NSE regular close, Friday 6 Nov 2026; 8 Nov is a Sunday)
inputs.net_debt_note: Q2 FY2027 press release 'Net Cash Surplus and Debt to Equity' table (30 Sep 2026): cash & equivalents 13,294 + investments 73,376 = 86,670; less restricted cash 214 and equity investments 3,172 (carried separately in the equity bridge) = cash 83,284. Borrowings 72,287 (short-term 58,260 + long-term 14,027), of which 14,027 are lease liabilities that the company itself excludes from net debt; ex-lease debt 58,260. Net cash INR 25,024m, which ties exactly to the company's own 'Net Cash Surplus' of 25,024 and net debt/equity of (0.06).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in INR, the currency of the flows. Risk-free: India 10-year G-sec ~6.5% (2026). Equity risk premium ~6% for India (mature-market 4.5-5% plus country premium). Beta ~0.7 (large-cap defensive pharma; low correlation with Nifty). Cost of equity ~10.7%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~7% on short-term export packing credit / working-capital lines, ~5.3% after tax at 25%; debt is ~5-8% of capital. Blended WACC ~10.3%, rounded to 10.5%. The same WACC is used in all three scenarios: risk is charged once, in the probability-weighted flows, not again in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Consolidated lease liabilities (INR 14,027m at 30 Sep 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; the full lease cash cost (principal ~1,263m + interest ~250m FY2026 = ~0.5% of revenue) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; da_pct_path is depreciation ex right-of-use (~5.8% of revenue vs 6.1% reported) so the lease is charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; non-controlling interests (INR 3,394m at 31 Mar 2026, Nestle medical-nutrition JV and others) deducted once, at book, in the equity bridge. NCI share of profit was a loss of 384m in FY2026, so attributable profit exceeded consolidated; the book deduction is the conservative side.
inputs.wc_note: Manufacturer with receivables (101bn) + inventories (81bn) far above payables (36bn) at 30 Sep 2026: net working capital ~40% of revenue and inventory days ~170. Growth consumes cash, so wc_capture_pct is NEGATIVE (-25% of each year's revenue increase). FY2024-25 conversion was worse (OCF lagged EBITDA-less-tax by ~50% of the revenue increase) but that included the NRT acquisition's inventory build; -25% is the normalised figure.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: branded and unbranded generics, biosimilars, consumer health, API/CDMO). Routed via .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md row 2 (non-US operating company) with the adaptations file applied: INR WACC, single lease treatment (B), NCI once in the bridge, equity investments added in the bridge because their income is not in the flows, SBC-light market. BASE-YEAR CHOICE: FY0 is FY2026 (revenue 335,933; owner FCF 19,714). FY2026 and FY2027 are trough years on earnings (gRevlimid cliff, INR 4.53bn shelf-stock charge in Q4 FY2026, INR 2.4bn semaglutide API provision in Q1 FY2027) but the component build does NOT extrapolate either the trough margin or the FY2023-25 lenalidomide-inflated 28-30% EBITDA margins: FY2027 is built at ~19.8% adjusted EBITDA (H1 actual 16.7% incl. the provision, Q2 20.6%, management guiding a stronger H2) and ramps to 23.5% by FY2031, roughly the pre-lenalidomide FY2019-21 level (22-25%) plus modest mix gain from biosimilars and consumer health. Year-1 owner FCF from the components (~INR 20bn) ties to FY2026 actual owner FCF, so no one-off is being carried forward. Capex is anchored at the current 10-11% of revenue (biosimilars, injectables and peptide capacity) and glides to 7%, the pre-2023 norm; D&A ex-ROU ~5.8-6.0%. Cash tax 25% (FY2026 cash taxes paid 24.5% of PBT, FY2025 26.3%; Indian statutory 25.17%). Terminal growth 4.0% INR nominal (India inflation ~4%), cap multiple 18x. Horizon 10 years because margins and capex intensity are still normalising through FY2031.

bear.rationale: One of the 2026 Form 483s (Bachupally biologics, Srikakulam, FTO-3) escalates to a Warning Letter or Import Alert, delaying abatacept and US launches; semaglutide supply stays constrained into FY2028 and prices erode fast once multiple Indian generics launch; US generics price erosion and API customer backward-integration keep gross margin under pressure; the Section 232 generics exemption is narrowed at the April 2027 review. Margin stalls at 20%. Same WACC.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +1%: H1 FY2027 revenue -3.5% YoY (North America -29% on gRevlimid), H2 against a weak Q4 FY2026 comparator (shelf-stock charge) with semaglutide supply resuming; FY2028-30 +9-10% once lenalidomide is out of the base and India (+12-16%), Emerging Markets (+10-15%), Europe/NRT (+8-10%), biosimilars (rituximab US via Fresenius, abatacept if approved) and semaglutide roll-outs show through; decays to 4.5% by FY2036 as semaglutide prices erode and the biosimilar pipeline matures.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA (reported + 0.1% SBC). FY2027 19.8% = H1 actual 16.7% incl. the 2.4bn semaglutide provision, Q2 20.6%, H2 ~22-23% as guided directionally; ramps to 23.5%, the FY2019-21 pre-lenalidomide band (22-25%) plus mix gain. Never returns to the FY2023-25 28-30% that only gRevlimid delivered.

bull.rationale: Semaglutide relaunch succeeds and extends to Brazil/Turkey and more markets on patent expiry; abatacept IV approved and the ~15-product biosimilars portfolio compounds; NRT consumer platform scales; capex intensity normalises faster as the biologics capacity comes on stream. Margin reaches management's long-standing 25%+ aspiration. Same WACC (risk charged once).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the downside axes are concrete and already partly realised in 2026: three Form 483s at different sites in four months (a single-regulator dependency on USFDA for the biosimilars thesis), a flagship-product quality failure (semaglutide API) and a sell-side downgrade to Sell. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once: semaglutide relaunch at scale, abatacept approval, biosimilar partner execution (Alvotech's own CRL) and a faster capex normalisation. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
